settings.appearance.intro: Adjust the theme and writing typography. Previews are applied immediately; Save makes the choice persistent.

settings.appearance.line_spacing_help: Controls the vertical space between lines in the writing editor.
settings.appearance.indent_help: Following paragraphs are indented. The first paragraph of a chapter, after a blank line, subheading or scene break starts flush left.
settings.appearance.paragraph_spacing_he: Adds subtle extra space between consecutive paragraphs.
settings.appearance.smart_quotes_help: Converts a straight double quotation mark typed in the editor into a typographic opening or closing quote.
settings.storage.intro: Choose where QuietWriter stores books and supporting files.
settings.storage.workspace_help: Your books, planning, publication structure and local recovery data are stored here. A change takes effect after restart.
settings.storage.cover_path_help: Used in Markdown metadata. Use {slug}, for example /{slug}.jpg or /images/{slug}.jpg.
settings.ai.intro: The AI assistant only helps when you ask it to, for example with feedback or analysis. It never edits your manuscript autonomously. QuietWriter does not include an AI model itself: connect a local model through Ollama or an external model through OpenRouter.
settings.ai.provider_help: Ollama runs locally on your computer. OpenRouter uses an external API key.
settings.ai.ollama_url_help: Only relevant when Ollama is selected as provider.
settings.ai.openrouter_key_help: Only relevant when OpenRouter is selected. The key is stored locally in your QuietWriter settings.
settings.ai.model_help: QuietWriter sends only the context selected in the AI sidebar together with your writer persona.
settings.spelling.intro: Manage spell checking and discovered Hunspell dictionaries.
settings.spelling.check_help: Underlines unknown words in the editor. Your manuscript text is never changed automatically.
settings.spelling.language_help: QuietWriter uses a discovered Hunspell dictionary for this language.
settings.spelling.manage_help: QuietWriter searches the workspace and installed ONLYOFFICE, LibreOffice and OpenOffice versions. You can also add a .dic/.aff dictionary yourself.
about.title: About {app}
about.intro: QuietWriter is a calm local writing environment for writing, structuring and preparing books. The application is designed to keep the text central and add as little visual noise as possible.
